title: Ordinary Human intake: narrow the rollback snapshot under StateInner
outcome: Human intake failure restoration preserves all queue, capacity and pause effects without copying the entire transcript on every send under the global state mutex.
acceptance: Human intake captures only the fields it can mutate for rollback, preserving the original queue, delivery/control evidence, capacity retry and pause state on failure without copying the full transcript.
Meaningful rollback regressions and independent review validate the narrow snapshot; any performance claim names a measured input and result.
